items.notes: Fast, clear delivery. Sampled videos had no uploaded French CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.why: Short news and society videos with heavy burned-in subtitles.
items.notes: Natural speed; subtitles burned in. Sampled videos had no uploaded French CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Norman
items.creator: Norman Thavaud
items.why: Classic French YouTube comedy sketches about everyday life; fast casual French.
items.notes: Fast, slangy speech. Sampled videos had no uploaded French CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Mcfly et Carlito
items.creator: David Coscas, Raphaël Carlier
items.why: Duo comedy challenges; very fast banter and slang.
items.notes: Fast, overlapping speech. Sampled videos had no uploaded French CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Le Monde
items.creator: Le Monde
items.why: Newspaper's video explainers and documentaries in formal French.
items.notes: Formal register. One of three sampled videos had uploaded French CC. Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: ARTE
items.creator: ARTE
items.why: Franco-German cultural channel: documentaries on history, science and society.
items.notes: Formal narration, specialist vocabulary. Sampled videos had no uploaded French CC (auto-generated only). Channel ID read from the channel page on 2026-11-06.

items.title: Contes en français (Global Storybooks)
items.creator: Global Storybooks / African Storybook (translations)
items.why: 40 illustrated stories tagged Niveau 1-5 with audio; level-1 stories have one short sentence per page.
items.notes: Enumerate from the index or level pages (/storybooks-french/stories/fr/level1 ... level5). Story pages /stories/fr/NNNN/ are plain HTML (0087 = 'J'aime lire'). Same story IDs as the Spanish and Japanese sites, so they can be compared side by side.

items.title: StoryWeaver (histoires en français)
items.creator: Pratham Books
items.why: About 1,350 free picture books in French with publisher levels 1-4, e.g. 'Le gros roi et le chien maigre' (level 1).

links.site: Le gros roi et le chien maigre (L1 example)

items.notes: Enumerate: https://storyweaver.org.in/api/v1/books-search?languages[]=French&levels[]=1&per_page=24&page=N. Counts 2026-11-06: L1 506, L2 488, L3 249, L4 105. The reader is a JS app (the /read API returns 401 without a session). CC BY 4.0.

items.title: African Storybook (livres en français)
items.creator: Saide / African Storybook
items.why: Openly licensed picture books for early readers, with French among the languages; source of the Global Storybooks texts.
items.notes: The site is a JS app with a language filter; I found no simple index or API, so Global Storybooks is the easier fetchable mirror. CC BY licences.

items.title: Pepper&Carrot
items.creator: David Revoy
items.why: A French creator's open-licence webcomic: short gag episodes about a little witch and her cat, with little text per page.
items.notes: CC BY 4.0, a legally free French BD. Episode list at /fr/webcomics/peppercarrot.html. Text is in the images.

items.title: 1jour1actu
items.creator: Milan Presse (Bayard)
items.why: Daily news explained for 8-12-year-olds in short, clear articles with videos ('1 jour 1 question').
items.notes: Bot protection: the site returned 403 to my scripted fetches and to WebFetch, so the URL was confirmed through search results (Vikidia, Milan Presse) rather than by loading it. Article listing/RSS still needs checking in a real browser.

items.title: Journal en français facile (RFI)
items.creator: RFI (Radio France Internationale)
items.why: A 10-minute daily world news bulletin in simplified French, posted with a full transcript and exercises.
items.notes: The host exists (it returned 403 to automated fetches, and the rfi.fr domain is blocked for my tools). The URL and the transcript claim were confirmed via search results and third-party listings. Exact episode-list and RSS URLs still need checking in a real browser. Daily on weekdays at 16:00 GMT.

items.title: News in Slow French
items.creator: Linguistica 360
items.why: Weekly news at Beginner (A1-A2), Intermediate and Advanced levels with slow audio and transcripts.
items.notes: Subscription with a 7-day trial; the sister Spanish site says every lesson has a free partial audio and transcript.

items.title: Vikidia, l'encyclopédie des 8-13 ans
items.creator: Vikidia community
items.why: Encyclopedia articles written for 8-13-year-olds: shorter sentences and simpler vocabulary than Wikipedia.
items.notes: MediaWiki API https://fr.vikidia.org/w/api.php (list=random, allpages, categorymembers). Wikimini (https://fr.wikimini.org/wiki/Accueil) is a similar encyclopedia written by children.

items.title: Project Gutenberg (livres en français)
items.creator: Project Gutenberg
items.why: Thousands of public-domain French books as HTML, from children's readers to Verne and Hugo.
items.notes: Enumerate with https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/feeds/pg_catalog.csv (filter Language=fr, Type=Text). HTML at https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/{id}/pg{id}-images.html. Beware: some IDs are audiobooks, e.g. 20972 Perrault has no HTML text.

items.title: Le tour de la France par deux enfants
items.creator: G. Bruno
items.why: An 1877 primary-school reader: short chapters with clear, didactic sentences, though the vocabulary is dated.
items.notes: 19th-century patriotic and moral tone.

items.title: Le tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
items.titleEn: Around the World in Eighty Days
items.creator: Jules Verne
items.why: A fast-moving adventure with a well-known plot; one of the more readable 19th-century classics.

items.title: Lettres de mon moulin
items.creator: Alphonse Daudet
items.why: Short stand-alone Provençal tales (e.g. 'La chèvre de M. Seguin') taught in French schools; literary past tenses.

items.title: Le petit Chaperon rouge
items.creator: Charles Perrault
items.why: A very short tale with a plot everyone knows; 17th-century wording and passé simple.
items.notes: The first link is an editions page; the text link is the 1902 edition.

items.title: Le Corbeau et le Renard
items.creator: Jean de La Fontaine
items.why: A short, famous fable every French child memorises; verse with classical word order.
items.notes: Full collection index: https://fr.wikisource.org/wiki/Fables_de_La_Fontaine.

items.title: Wikisource en français
items.creator: Wikimedia community
items.why: The largest open library of French public-domain texts as clean HTML, including tales and fables.
items.notes: MediaWiki API https://fr.wikisource.org/w/api.php (list=search, categorymembers). Missing pages return HTTP 404. Many titles are editions pages linking to per-edition texts.

items.title: Wattpad en français
items.creator: Wattpad
items.why: Free amateur French fiction in informal, dialogue-heavy, mostly young-adult language.
items.notes: Quality varies. Romance-heavy, some mature content. French-native alternative: Fyctia (https://www.fyctia.com/), a writing-contest platform run by a publisher.

items.title: Maru, mon toutou
items.creator: Mojo
items.why: A gentle Korean gag webtoon with short episodes and simple everyday lines.
items.notes: Official French translation of a Korean original.

items.title: My Giant Nerd Boyfriend
items.creator: fishball
items.why: One-page gag strips with one or two lines of everyday couple dialogue.

items.title: Monsieur Le Prof
items.creator: Monsieur Le Prof / Catsass
items.why: French-made webtoon of short, funny classroom scenes; everyday spoken French.
items.notes: Native French content (not a translation). Spoken register and slang.

items.title: Extra-Coloc
items.creator: Anne Masse
items.why: Comedy listed under slice of life; everyday young-adult dialogue in French.
items.notes: Appears on the French WEBTOON slice-of-life list; check whether it is a local original.

items.title: Le Tiroir Magique de Nina
items.creator: RD
items.why: A French-language fantasy webtoon listed among the French originals; level is an estimate, check it against an episode.
items.notes: The English title is my translation; there is no official English edition.

items.title: Lecteur omniscient
items.creator: Sleepy-C / UMI / sing N song
items.why: A hit Korean fantasy webtoon in official French; game-system vocabulary but strong visual support.
items.notes: Violence.

items.title: Lookism
items.creator: Taejun Park
items.why: A popular Korean high-school drama in official French, with slangy teen dialogue.
items.notes: Violence and bullying.

items.title: Le Petit Prince
items.creator: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry
items.why: The most common first French book among learners: short, simple sentences, but philosophical, with passé simple.
items.notes: Published by Gallimard (Folio, ISBN 9782070408504). Public domain in some countries but not in France, so no text link.

items.title: Le Petit Nicolas
items.creator: René Goscinny, Jean-Jacques Sempé
items.why: Short funny stories told by a schoolboy; guides rate it A2-B1 and learner editions with glossaries exist.
items.notes: Written around 1960, so some dated words. Childlike run-on narration.

items.title: Astérix
items.creator: René Goscinny, Albert Uderzo
items.why: Classic Franco-Belgian BD with lots of pictures, but puns, wordplay and Latin jokes make it harder than it looks.
items.notes: Not legally free online.

items.title: Les Aventures de Tintin
items.creator: Hergé
items.why: Clear-line BD whose pictures carry the story; standard written French in speech bubbles, plus Haddock's creative insults.
items.notes: Not legally free online. Early albums contain colonial-era stereotypes.

items.title: Short Stories in French for Beginners
items.titleEn: Short Stories in French for Beginners
items.creator: Olly Richards, Richard Simcott (Teach Yourself)
items.why: Eight graded stories for A1-B1 with summaries, French-English glossaries and multiple-choice questions.
items.notes: ISBN 9781473683433. Audiobook narrated by Louis Bernard.

items.title: Introduction to French
items.creator: Language Transfer
items.why: Free audio course that gets beginners building French sentences by reasoning about structure and English cognates.
items.notes: step 1. Free (donations/Patreon). Shorter intro course rather than a 'Complete' series. LT app, SoundCloud, YouTube, zip download. Taught in English.

items.title: Apprendre le français avec TV5MONDE
items.creator: TV5MONDE
items.why: Free exercises built on real TV clips, sorted by CEFR level from A1 (complete beginner) to B2.
items.notes: step 2. Free website and free app. Interface in 9 languages besides French: German, English, Arabic, Korean, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese, Russian, Vietnamese (official TV5MONDE help page). Site blocks automated fetches - verified via official FAQ and search results, not a page load.

items.title: Alice Ayel
items.creator: Alice Ayel
items.why: Slow, visual French stories for beginners in the comprehensible-input style, all in French.
items.notes: step 3: listening from week 1. Free YouTube; paid courses on aliceayel.com. Language-neutral (French only), good for non-English natives.

items.title: Learn French With Alexa
items.creator: Alexa Polidoro
items.why: Long-running beginner video lessons by a French teacher covering pronunciation, basic grammar and first phrases.
items.notes: step 3: explained basics. Free YouTube; paid courses at learnfrenchwithalexa.com. English explanations.

items.title: Coffee Break French
items.creator: Coffee Break Languages
items.why: Beginner podcast where a teacher and learner work through phrases and grammar step by step.
items.notes: step 4. Podcasts free; per-level courses are one-time purchases. Taught in English. First Steps link taken from the official site, not fetched separately.

items.title: Le français facile avec RFI
items.creator: RFI (Radio France Internationale)
items.why: Free podcasts and exercises sorted by level (beginner to advanced), plus the daily 10-minute 'Journal en français facile' with transcript.
items.notes: step 4+ (the slow news is A2-B1; use the beginner-tagged exercises earlier). Entirely free. savoirs.rfi.fr now redirects here. Site blocks automated fetches - verified by redirect and search results. Interface languages not confirmed.

items.title: BBC Languages - French
items.titleEn: BBC - Learn French with free online lessons
items.creator: BBC
items.why: Archived but online: French alphabet guide, 'Talk French' video introduction and 'The French Experience' beginner course.
items.notes: reference only. Mothballed site; some media may not play. Talk French: /languages/french/talk/; alphabet: /languages/french/guide/alphabet.shtml.

items.title: Duolingo French
items.creator: Duolingo
items.why: Free bite-size daily lessons for vocabulary and habit.
items.notes: daily habit. Free app/web, optional subscription. Verified URL is for English speakers; French is offered from many other base languages in the app. LingoDeer (https://www.lingodeer.com/, freemium) also teaches French.
